sentences.text: The sensor data indicates a cold spot in the living room, which began at 04:20 and lasted until 06:00.
The observed temperature of 16.9 °C was significantly lower than the expected 18.0 °C, falling outside the expected range of 17.7 °C to 18.6 °C.
This sudden drop, which peaked at 05:20, was probably caused by a draft or a window being opened.
